type:
∀ (x p : NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.Word) (b : Bool),
  NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.writeBit x p b =
    if BitVec.toNat p < 63 then
      if b = true then x ||| 1#63 <<< BitVec.toNat p
      else x &&& (NativeBridge.Incremental.Uint63Operations.largest ^^^ 1#63 <<< BitVec.toNat p)
    else x
